Name: KyuubiSoftAPI
Description: REST API for KyuubiSoft Panel - player data (real health/gamemode), real per-world TPS and tick time, player actions (heal/kill/teleport/gamemode/clear-inventory via in-process commands), real-time events (per-world tps_update, player_death with killer, periodic player_position with real ping), and Prometheus metrics. Every request needs the panel's bearer token.
